learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn the magic trick to change one thing into many things by adding a magical 's'!
warm_up_hook: 📖 Hello little friend! Look at the night sky. Do you see just one star, or do you see many stars? Today, we will learn how to turn one single thing into a big group of many things!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: When we have only one thing, we call it 'One'. It stands all alone. Like one red apple or one cute cat.
When we have two, three, or more things, we call it 'Many'. They make a big fun group together!
How do we change one to many? We use magic! Just add the small letter 's' at the end of the word.

practice_quiz.question: ❓ I have one bat. My friend has two ___.
❓ What is the 'many' word for 🌳 Tree?

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The 'S' Monster Game!
fun_activity.instructions: Run around your house and touch things. If it is one, say its name softly. If there are many, roar its name with an 's' like a happy monster!

chapter_summary: ⭐ One means only a single thing.
⭐ Many means two or more things together.
⭐ We add a magic 's' at the end to make a word mean many!
